records.text: :tada: New signup: *Timber Works* just joined on the team plan!

decisions.rationale: Owen is engaged and replied positively that the first project is "starting to click" [email:87d30ac1], project reached day 1, team plan, 8 days left. But no invite sent and key milestone unreached with no stated plan to add teammates, so activation is plausible but not likely without a nudge.

draft.subject: Re: Checking in on Timber Works' setup
draft.body:
Hi Owen,

Glad to hear the first project is starting to click — that's usually the moment things get useful. Since projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, the natural next step is bringing someone else in: a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Happy to walk through that first invite with you on a short call this week if it helps — otherwise just reply and I'll point you to the right spot.

Best,
Chidi
